direction.thesis: A luminous training instrument for fast set logging, refusing a generic fitness dashboard grid.
direction.ownWorld: True-black field, charcoal plates, cool periwinkle actions, pale-cyan live information, and sparing warm-peach records.
direction.story: Resume or choose a routine, record the current set beside prior truth, recover safely, then review history and progress.
direction.firstViewport: Compact header, dominant start or resume plate, and ranked routine rail above shallow thumb navigation.
direction.form: A current-exercise ledger with one truth per control and damped, functional motion.
direction.finish: Store this design system and enforce it on every future change.

tokens.fontFamily: Roboto, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

components.setLedger: Keep previous truth adjacent to separate kg, reps, RIR, and completion controls.
components.numericSheet: Large numeric entry with focus trap, Escape dismissal, and focus restoration.
components.finishSheet: Concise summary with protected-draft failure recovery and guarded discard.
components.restDock: Single pale-cyan live state with timestamp-derived countdown and Skip action.
components.bottomNavigation: Home, Routines, History, and Progress only; absent during Active Workout.
components.recordPanel: Warm peach reserved for meaningful personal-record emphasis.

states.pending: Label the in-flight action while retaining context.
states.writeFailure: Preserve data, surface the failure, and expose retry.
states.loadFailure: Never masquerade as empty; explain protection and expose retry.
states.draftConflict: Prefer newer draft and allow restoring the alternate.
states.destructive: Require explicit confirmation and explain loss or recalculation.
